summary.en: The Cordis foundation under dsh — there is no privileged core to patch. Plugins contribute services, typed events, and reversible effects to a shared context.
summary.zh: dsh 底层的 Cordis 根基——没有需要修补的特权核心。插件向共享上下文贡献服务、类型化事件与可逆副作用。

title.zh: Profile 与 Bundle 组合层

summary.en: How a running dsh is composed at boot — ordered layers of bundles, profiles, and patches that turn an empty plugin tree into a product.
summary.zh: 运行中的 dsh 如何在启动时被组合——bundle、profile 与 patch 的分层，把一个空插件树组装成产品。

summary.en: The packages that own the harness spine — session, tools, agent, agent-loop, system-prompt, llm — and the ctx keys they claim.
summary.zh: 拥有 harness 主干的服务包——session、tools、agent、agent-loop、system-prompt、llm——以及它们认领的 ctx key。

summary.en: Events are the extension points of dsh — three domains (session, agent, capability) with four dispatch modes, and the rule for picking the right one.
summary.zh: 事件是 dsh 的扩展点——三个领域（session、agent、capability）四种分发模式，以及挑选正确领域/模式的规则。

summary.en: How one model request plus its tool calls becomes a step, how steps compose into turns, and where the loop's extension points sit.
summary.zh: 一次模型请求加上它的工具调用如何成为一个 step，step 如何组成 turn，以及循环的扩展点在哪里。

summary.en: The log is the source of the context the model sees — and a runtime invariant asserts that anything model-visible is reconstructable from it.
summary.zh: 日志是模型所见上下文的来源——运行时不变式断言：任何模型可见的内容都能从它重建。

summary.en: A seam is a swappable capability with three roles — Service Definition, Service Provider, Consumer — and why one provider swap changes the whole product.
summary.zh: 接缝是一种可替换能力，含三个角色——服务定义、服务提供者、消费者——以及为什么一次 provider 替换就能改变整个产品。

summary.en: Where new behavior goes — the documented extension points, the register-don't-edit rule, and why locking to a version matters while dsh is in developer preview.
summary.zh: 新行为放哪里——文档化的扩展点、"注册而非修改"规则，以及 developer preview 阶段为什么锁定版本很重要。
